content: The function WdgM_GetFirstExpiredSEID() shall read the SEID from non - initialized RAM location, stored as a double - inverse value. In case the value and the inverse value do not correspond to each other, then the function shall return E_NOT_OK and shall write 0 to *SEID . In case the value and the inverse value correspond, the function shall return E_OK and set write the read value to *SEID .
